notes_for_parent: V5 is the only case in the V-family that pins an ABSENT source path; it complements V1 (clean pair -> VERIFIED) by isolating source presence as the sole failing conjunct.
The round-2 baseline (NOT-SAFE(unreachable)) is the strongest evidence that the r4 harness needs a ledger-first branch; the r2 tool never even sees the row.

The selftest is --tool aware: it recognizes the r2 sha and pins that exact class, and holds any other candidate to NOT-VERIFIED(source-absent). Do not change the r2 sha constant unless tools/souji-verify.sh is replaced.
